Conditionally required: for adjustment categories configured to require a vendor, which is typically an expense category, and for Global Payroll contracts whenever the organization has the compliance check enabled, which applies to any category. Leave the field out entirely when it does not apply - sending it empty is rejected, because the length constraint still applies to a value that is present.

bodyProps.name: country
bodyProps.description: Country the expense was incurred in, which is not necessarily the contract country. Conditionally required: for adjustment categories configured to require a country, which is typically an expense category, and for Global Payroll contracts whenever the organization has the compliance check enabled, which applies to any category. Leave the field out entirely when it does not apply - sending it empty is rejected, because the pattern still applies to a value that is present.

bodyProps.name: odp_only
bodyProps.description: EOR contracts only. Restrict the adjustment to on-demand payroll: when true it is never attached to a regular payroll cycle, and it is automatically denied if it is still not part of an on-demand payroll 30 days after creation. Sending it for any other contract type is rejected, because on-demand payroll does not exist there. Editable only through this API, and it forces move_next_cycle to false.

descriptors.summary: Assign application to interview plan stage

params.name: application_id
params.description: ID of the application to be associated with the interview plan stage

bodyProps.name: creator_id
bodyProps.description: HRIS Organization User ID recorded as the user who moved the application. Honoured for service account callers only; any other caller is always recorded as themselves.

bodyProps.name: delay_unit
bodyProps.description: The unit of time for the delay. Must be provided together with delay_amount. Cannot be used together with scheduled_send_at.

bodyProps.name: delay_amount
bodyProps.description: The amount of time to delay the archivation email. Must be provided together with delay_unit. Cannot be used together with scheduled_send_at.

bodyProps.name: is_current_stage
bodyProps.description: When true, sets this stage as the application's current stage in the hiring workflow. When false, creates a historical record without changing the application's current stage.

bodyProps.name: scheduled_send_at
bodyProps.description: The exact future datetime to send the archivation email. Cannot be used together with delay_amount/delay_unit.

bodyProps.name: interview_plan_stage_id
bodyProps.description: The ID of the interview plan stage to associate with the application

bodyProps.name: applicable_job_activities
bodyProps.description: Optional array of job activities to trigger when associating the application with this stage. If not provided, all activities will be triggered. If an empty array is provided, no activities will be triggered.

bodyProps.name: candidate_archivation_reason_id
bodyProps.description: Optional ID of the archivation reason if the candidate is being archived

bodyProps.name: candidate_archivation_email_template_id
bodyProps.description: Optional ID of the rejection email template if the candidate is being archived

bodyProps.name: expected_current_interview_plan_stage_id
bodyProps.description: Optional precondition: the application's current interview plan stage ID as last read. If the application has moved since, nothing changes and a 409 precondition_failed is returned.

descriptors.summary: Retrieve a list of ATS applications

params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor for pagination. Use the nextCursor value from the previous response to get the next page of results.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of applications to return per page

params.name: search_text
params.description: Search text to filter applications

params.name: job_id
params.description: Filter by job ID

params.name: job_ids
params.description: Return applications to any of these jobs (up to 100). Combined with job_id as one set. Jobs the caller cannot access are left out silently rather than rejected.

params.name: hiring_member_hou_ids
params.description: Return applications to jobs on whose hiring team one of these HRIS organization users sits (up to 100) — a person's pipeline. Always intersected with the jobs the caller can access.

params.name: hiring_member_role_ids
params.description: Narrow hiring_member_hou_ids to jobs where those people hold one of these roles (up to 100), using the role_id values returned by the hiring members list. Requires hiring_member_hou_ids. Only organizations that use roles and permissions have per-job roles; others get a 400.

params.name: interview_plan_stage_ids
params.description: Filter by the CURRENT interview plan stage IDs (comma-separated). Applications that have since moved to another stage are excluded — use reached_interview_plan_stage_ids for those.

params.name: reached_interview_plan_stage_ids
params.description: Filter by interview plan stage IDs the application has EVER been in (comma-separated), including applications that have since advanced, been hired or been archived.

params.name: moved_to_current_stage_before
params.description: Return only applications that moved to their current stage strictly before this ISO 8601 datetime (stalled candidates)

params.name: archivation_reason_ids
params.description: Filter by archivation reason IDs (comma-separated); see GET /rest/ats/reasons with reason_group_slug=CANDIDATE_ARCHIVATION

params.name: candidate_tag_ids_operator
params.description: How candidate_tag_ids are combined: ANY (default) matches candidates with at least one of the tags, ALL requires every tag

params.name: include
params.description: Optional expansions to embed on each item. STAGE_HISTORY adds the full stage timeline with entered/exited timestamps.

params.name: candidate_tag_ids
params.description: Filter by candidate tag IDs (comma-separated)

params.name: source_slugs
params.description: Filter by application source (comma-separated)

params.name: job_criterias_matchings
params.description: Filter applications by job criteria matching state

params.name: current_stage_category_type_slugs
params.description: Filter applications by current stage category type slugs. Accepted values are lead, active and completed, in either case — the job list reports them uppercase and this filter accepts that form too.

params.name: current_stage_default_type_slugs
params.description: Filter applications by current stage default type slugs (e.g. new_lead, application_review, offer, hired, archived), in either case. Use 'others' for custom stages.

params.name: updated_after
params.description: Filter applications updated after this timestamp (ISO 8601 format)

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Field to sort applications by

params.name: sort_order
params.description: Sort order for applications

properties.name: id
properties.description: The unique ID assigned by the system to this variable compensation record.

properties.name: type
properties.description: The way the compensation is calculated. `FIXED` means a fixed amount (like $1000). `PERCENTAGE` means it’s based on a percentage of the salary.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Title or name of the variable compensation.

properties.name: amount
properties.description: The value of the compensation. Shown as a string to keep the exact number of decimals.

properties.name: timeline
properties.description: How often the compensation is paid — for example monthly, quarterly, annually, or twice a year.

properties.name: parent_id
properties.description: Reference to the parent variable compensation, if applicable. Null if this compensation is not linked to any compensation.

properties.name: created_at
properties.description: The date and time when this record was first created in the system.

properties.name: is_amended
properties.description: Shows whether this compensation has been changed as part of an amendment.

properties.name: is_deleted
properties.description: Shows whether this compensation has been deleted.

properties.name: updated_at
properties.description: The date and time when this record was last updated.

properties.name: effective_date
properties.description: The date when this compensation starts being valid.

properties.name: incentive_plan
properties.description: Details of the incentive plan linked to this compensation, if any.

properties.name: details
properties.description: Extra details about the incentive plan, if any.

properties.name: employee_signature
properties.description: The employee’s signature for the incentive plan, if collected.

properties.name: employee_signed_at
properties.description: The date and time when the employee signed the incentive plan. Empty if not signed.

responseFields.name: benefits
responseFields.description: All benefits associated with this contract, regardless of enrollment status. Includes benefits the employee is enrolled in, has opted out of, or is pending enrollment for.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Unique identifier (UUID) for this benefit instance. Use this when referencing the benefit in subsequent API calls.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Human-readable display name of the benefit (e.g. 'Healthcare', 'Dental', '401(k)'). Suitable for display in UI.

properties.name: type
properties.description: High-level category of the benefit (e.g. HEALTHCARE, DENTAL, VISION). May be null if uncategorized. Use benefit_type_code for a more specific, jurisdiction-aware value.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Enrollment lifecycle state for this benefit. Populated with the same value as `enrollment_status` (both fields are returned for backward compatibility). ENROLLED = active, claimable coverage. OPTED_OUT = employee stopped or waived the coverage. TERMINATED = cancelled mid-contract. EXPIRED = coverage period ended. PENDING, AWAITING_ENROLLMENT, AWAITING_CARRIER_CONFIRMATION, and AWAITING_CONTRACT_ACTIVATION indicate transitional or pre-active states; see `enrollment_status` for the same enumeration and definitions.

properties.name: end_date
properties.description: Date on which this benefit's coverage ends (ISO 8601, `YYYY-MM-DD`). Benefit record's effective end, termination, or offer end where applicable. Null or absent when no definitive end date is set on this record (coverage may still change if the contract or offering is updated).

properties.name: plan_url
properties.description: URL to this specific plan's portal or documentation — for example, a plan summary PDF, carrier-hosted plan detail page, or plan materials. Distinct from `provider_website_url` (the provider organization as a whole) and `home_page_url` (employee portal for claims and ID cards).

properties.name: description
properties.description: Plain-text explanation of what this benefit covers and why it matters to the employee. Suitable for display in a benefits overview UI or summary card.

properties.name: contract_type
properties.description: Workforce product for the contract this benefit belongs to. EOR — Employer of Record; Deel is the legal employer. GP — Global Payroll; the client is the legal employer and Deel runs payroll. PEO — Professional Employer Organization (US co-employment). EMBEDDED — payroll or HR through an embedded partner integration.

properties.name: provider_name
properties.description: Display name of the insurance carrier or benefit provider administering this plan (for example Allianz, Cigna, ManuLife).

properties.name: coverage_group
properties.description: Who is covered under this benefit, derived from enrolled dependents on the contract benefit. EMPLOYEE = employee only. EMPLOYEE_AND_SPOUSE = employee plus legal spouse. EMPLOYEE_AND_DOMESTIC_PARTNER = employee plus registered domestic partner where applicable. EMPLOYEE_AND_CHILD = employee plus dependent child coverage structured as a single-child tier. EMPLOYEE_AND_CHILDREN = employee plus all enrolled children. EMPLOYEE_AND_FAMILY = employee plus spouse or partner and children (full family tier) per plan rules.

properties.name: effective_date
properties.description: Date from which this benefit offering is in effect for this employee in this response (ISO 8601, `YYYY-MM-DD`). The benefit offering's offered-at date when present — not the same as contract coverage start or plan-specific coverage start dates inside enrollment.

properties.name: benefit_type_code
properties.description: Jurisdiction-aware classification code for this benefit. Use this (not only `type`) when product logic must differ by country — for example retirement: `401_K` in the US versus `OCCUPATIONAL_PENSION` in the UK and Ireland. Other common values include HEALTHCARE, DENTAL, VISION, LIFE_INSURANCE, ACCIDENT_INSURANCE, and CRITICAL_ILLNESS; the full set may expand as new benefit types are added.

properties.name: enrollment_status
properties.description: Enrollment lifecycle state for this benefit. Always matches `status` in this API version; both are returned so integrations can use the explicit `enrollment_status` name. PENDING = benefit exists but no enrollment action yet. AWAITING_ENROLLMENT = employee must complete enrollment while an enrollment window applies. AWAITING_CARRIER_CONFIRMATION = submission received; awaiting carrier or administrator confirmation. AWAITING_CONTRACT_ACTIVATION = enrollment cannot complete until the underlying employment contract is active. ENROLLED = active coverage. OPTED_OUT = employee stopped or waived the coverage. TERMINATED = stopped before natural expiry. EXPIRED = coverage window has ended.

properties.name: enrollment_window
properties.description: Calendar window during which the employee may enroll in, change, or opt out of this benefit. Omitted when no window is returned (enrollment changes are then not accepted until a new window opens, for example open enrollment, a qualifying life event, or a new-hire cycle per employer configuration).

properties.name: ends_at
properties.description: Last date the enrollment window is open (ISO 8601, `YYYY-MM-DD`). After this date, enrollment is locked until a new window is triggered.

properties.name: trigger
properties.description: Business reason this window was opened. new_hire = initial enrollment after onboarding completes. open_enrollment = scheduled annual election period. qualifying_life_event = permitted mid-year change after a life event (for example marriage, birth, divorce) per plan rules. termination = window tied to offboarding, often for continuation or COBRA-style elections in applicable jurisdictions.

properties.name: starts_at
properties.description: First date the enrollment window is open (ISO 8601, `YYYY-MM-DD`). Enrollment actions are accepted on or after this date only.

properties.name: enrollment_details
properties.description: Details about the specific plan and provider the employee is currently enrolled in, along with the cost breakdown for the current billing cycle. Reflects the employee's actual enrollment, which may differ from organization_selection if the employee made their own plan choice.

properties.name: selected_plan
properties.description: The specific benefit plan the employee is enrolled in (e.g. 'Gold', 'Silver', 'Bronze'). Contains the plan's ID, display name, and downloadable plan documents.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Unique identifier for this benefit plan. Use when referencing the plan in enrollment or amendment API calls.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Display name of the plan tier (e.g. 'Gold', 'Silver', 'Bronze'). Shown to employees during enrollment selection and in benefits summaries.

properties.name: attachments
properties.description: Downloadable documents associated with this plan (e.g. Summary of Benefits and Coverage, Certificate of Coverage, plan brochure). Render each item as a labeled download link.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Unique identifier for this attachment document.

properties.name: url
properties.description: Direct URL to download or view the attachment. Typically a PDF. Use as the href for a download link.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Human-readable filename or label for the attachment (e.g. 'Canada_Benefits.pdf'). Use as the visible text for download links.

properties.name: selected_provider
properties.description: The insurance carrier or benefit administrator managing the employee's currently enrolled plan. Includes portal access URL and provider-level documents.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Unique identifier for this provider.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Display name of the insurance carrier or benefit provider (e.g. 'ManuLife', 'Aetna'). Use for labeling in UI.

properties.name: is_unisure
properties.description: True if this benefit is administered through Unisure, a global group insurance platform Deel uses to deliver international EOR benefits. Relevant for understanding the benefit's administration model and claims process.

properties.name: attachments
properties.description: Provider-level documents such as general coverage guides, network directories, or enrollment guides. Render each as a labeled download link.

properties.name: id

properties.description: URL to the employee-facing provider portal where the employee can view claims, access ID cards, find in-network providers, and manage coverage details.

properties.name: current_cycle_plan_cost
properties.description: Total cost of the selected plan for the current billing cycle, in the contract's currency. This is the gross plan cost before employer contributions are applied. Subtract current_cycle_employer_contribution to get the employee's net out-of-pocket cost. Null when no cost has been calculated for the current cycle yet.

properties.name: current_cycle_employer_contribution
properties.description: Amount the employer contributes toward the plan cost for the current billing cycle, in the contract's currency. This is the portion the company pays on the employee's behalf. The employee's actual cost is current_cycle_plan_cost minus this value. Null when no contribution has been calculated for the current cycle yet.

properties.name: provider_website_url
properties.description: Public marketing or corporate website for the carrier or administrator. For the employee-facing portal (claims, ID cards, provider search), use `home_page_url` when enrolled.

properties.name: employee_contribution
properties.description: Recurring portion of plan cost collected from the employee's pay for this benefit. Expressed with calculation metadata (`type`, `value`), resolved `amount`, `currency`, and `frequency`. For a given period, `employee_contribution.amount` plus `employer_contribution.amount` reflects the split of premium or plan cost represented here; use `enrollment_details` cycle fields when you need billed totals for the current cycle.

properties.name: type
properties.description: How the employee contribution is derived. FIXED_AMOUNT = flat currency per `frequency`. PERCENTAGE = percent of an earnings or cost basis defined by the plan. Additional values (for example employer match shapes on retirement benefits) can appear for specialized products.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Raw contribution input from configuration or upstream systems; may be a number or string (for example `"1.23"`). Use `amount` for display and arithmetic — it is the normalized numeric value in `currency` per `frequency`.

properties.name: amount
properties.description: Resolved employee contribution in `currency` for each `frequency` period (for example `100` with `USD` and `MONTHLY` means one hundred US dollars per month).

properties.name: currency
properties.description: ISO 4217 currency code for `amount` (for example USD, CAD, GBP). Matches the parent contract's `currency` for this benefits payload.

properties.name: frequency
properties.description: Payroll or billing cadence for this contribution. Typical values include MONTHLY, SEMI_MONTHLY (twice per month), BIWEEKLY, WEEKLY, and ANNUALLY; exact strings follow Deel payroll configuration.

properties.name: employer_contribution
properties.description: Recurring employer-paid portion for this benefit, same shape as `employee_contribution`. Together with `employee_contribution.amount`, describes how premium or plan cost is split for the modeled period; billed totals for the active cycle may also appear under `enrollment_details`.

properties.name: type
properties.description: How the employer contribution is derived. FIXED_AMOUNT = flat currency per `frequency`. PERCENTAGE = percent of an earnings or cost basis. Additional values may appear for specialized products.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Raw employer contribution input; may be number or string depending on source. Prefer `amount` for calculations and UI.

properties.name: amount
properties.description: Resolved employer contribution in `currency` per `frequency` period.

properties.name: currency
properties.description: ISO 4217 currency code for `amount`. Matches the parent contract's `currency`.

properties.name: frequency
properties.description: Cadence at which the employer contribution is applied. Same vocabulary as `employee_contribution.frequency`.

params.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for which to retrieve GP worker additional fields.

responseFields.name: key
responseFields.description: Use this value as the field identifier when submitting additional information. Represents the snake_case version of the internal field name, generated by the API naming convention service.

responseFields.name: type
responseFields.description: Use this value to determine the data type expected when submitting field values. Mapped from the raw input type: 'date', 'text', 'select', 'textarea', 'tel', 'phone', and 'string' map to "string"; 'number' maps to "number"; 'checkbox' maps to "boolean". An empty string indicates an unrecognized input type.

responseFields.name: ui_guide
responseFields.description: Use this object to control how the field is rendered in the UI. Contains labels, input type, display order, and supplementary text.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Use this value as the primary English-language label when rendering the field in the UI.

properties.name: order
properties.description: Use this value to determine the display position of the field in the form. Starts at 1 and reflects the position in the response array, which is pre-sorted by the configured display order.

properties.name: field_type
properties.description: Use this value to select the appropriate UI input component. Represents the raw input type from the field configuration. Known values include 'text', 'date', 'select', 'textarea', 'tel', 'phone', 'number', 'checkbox', and 'string'. Additional values may exist.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Use this value to display supplementary context about the field below or beside the input. HTML tags are stripped. Returns an empty string when no description is configured.

properties.name: helper_text
properties.description: Use this value to display footnote or instructional text near the field. HTML tags are stripped. Returns an empty string when no helper text is configured.

properties.name: local_label
properties.description: Use this value as the localized field label when rendering the form in the worker's local language.

responseFields.name: validation
responseFields.description: Use this array to apply client-side validation before form submission. Contains zero or one validation rule per field. An empty array means no validation is configured.

properties.name: type
properties.description: Use this value to determine which validation strategy to apply. "REGEX" indicates the 'value' field contains a regular expression pattern. Any other value indicates a custom validation type identified by its uppercase name.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Use this value as the validation parameter. For REGEX type, contains the regular expression pattern to validate the field input against. Absent when the validation type is a custom type that does not require a parameter.

properties.name: error_message
properties.description: Use this message to display to the user when the field value fails validation. Defaults to 'Review the value entered' when no custom message is configured.

responseFields.name: is_required
responseFields.description: Use this flag to determine whether the field must be provided when submitting additional information. For GP workers, the value considers the GP-specific optionality setting when available, falling back to the general optionality flag.

responseFields.name: required_by
responseFields.description: Use this value to determine at which stage in the payroll lifecycle this field must be collected. Known values: 'before_payroll' (required before payroll processing), 'after_payroll' (can be collected after initial payroll), 'contract_signing' (required at contract signing). Absent from the response when no lifecycle stage is configured.

responseFields.name: dependencies
responseFields.description: Use this array to implement conditional field visibility. When non-empty, this field should only be displayed and required when the referenced dependency conditions are met. An empty array means the field has no conditional dependencies.

properties.name: key
properties.description: Use this value to identify the field that this dependency refers to. Contains the snake_case key of the dependency field, matching another field's 'key' property in the same response.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Use this value to evaluate the dependency condition. When the value is a primitive (string, number, or boolean), the condition is satisfied when the referenced field equals this value. When the value is an array, the condition is satisfied when the referenced field equals any one of its entries. When the value is an object, apply the operator in 'op': 'eq' (equals), 'ne' (not equals), 'gt' (greater than), 'gte' (greater than or equal), 'lt' (less than), 'lte' (less than or equal), 'contains' (field value contains the specified substring) each compare against 'value', while 'notnull' takes no operand and is satisfied when the referenced field holds any non-empty value.

responseFields.name: values_allowed
responseFields.description: Use this array to populate dropdown or select options when field_type is 'select'. Only present when the field has predefined options. Absent from the response for free-text, date, number, and other non-select field types.

descriptors.summary: Create a collection for an IT asset

params.name: asset_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the IT asset

bodyProps.name: not_before
bodyProps.description: Earliest date Deel logistics may execute the pickup.

bodyProps.name: warehouse_id
bodyProps.description: Destination warehouse identifier for the collection. Mutually exclusive with `store_and_reuse_location`.

bodyProps.name: collection_address
bodyProps.description: Location the asset is being collected from.

properties.name: country
properties.description: Country the asset is being picked up from. Overrides the country the asset-action validator derives from asset state.

bodyProps.name: shipment_insurance
bodyProps.description: Insurance-consent flag and optional purchase details Deel records against the asset. May be omitted (or sent with `is_waived: false` and no `purchase_details`) if the asset already has a purchase price and date on record.

properties.name: is_waived
properties.description: Consent to ship without insurance. When true, `purchase_details` must be omitted and Deel will not record a purchase price against the asset.

properties.name: purchase_details
properties.description: Purchase details Deel records against the asset. Omit to fall back to purchase details already stored on the asset, if any. Must be omitted when `is_waived` is true.

properties.name: date
properties.description: Date the asset was purchased.

properties.name: price
properties.description: Purchase price paid for the asset.

properties.name: amount
properties.description: Amount

properties.name: currency
properties.description: Three-letter currency code for the price

bodyProps.name: store_and_reuse_location
bodyProps.description: Deel-managed reuse destination for the collection. Mutually exclusive with `warehouse_id`.

responseFields.name: id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the item

responseFields.name: grade

responseFields.description: Current state of the asset

responseFields.description: Actions the caller can execute on this asset, with availability status per action

its assigned rental contract billing entity country, or the last active

(e.g. asset was returned to Deel)

bodyProps.name: location
bodyProps.description:
Target location for the asset. Only WITH_USER and AT_WAREHOUSE are
accepted; other ItemLocation values are managed by Deel logistics and
rejected with 400. Supported values that produce a transition the
underlying self-serve workflow cannot perform (e.g. AT_WAREHOUSE ->
AT_WAREHOUSE) are rejected with 409 by the workflow's own asset_not_*
errors.

bodyProps.name: warehouse_id
bodyProps.description:
ID of the organization storage location the asset is being moved to.
Required when location is AT_WAREHOUSE; ignored when location is WITH_USER.

bodyProps.name: hris_profile_id
bodyProps.description:
HRIS profile ID of the user the asset is being moved to. Required when
location is WITH_USER; ignored when location is AT_WAREHOUSE.

params.name: search
params.description: Return products whose name or brand contains this text. Case-insensitive, and partial words match, so 'book' finds 'MacBook Pro'. Only the name and brand are searched — not the description or hardware specification. Use brands for an exact manufacturer match.

params.name: brands
params.description: Filter by manufacturer — exact and case-insensitive, repeat for OR semantics. Unlike search it does not substring-match.

params.name: it_policy_ids
params.description: Restrict results to products approved by any of these IT policies, to see what workers on those policies can order. Repeat for OR semantics. A policy id your organization does not own matches nothing.

params.name: is_marketplace
params.description: Filter by marketplace sourcing. Organizations without marketplace access never see marketplace products, and the filter is ignored for them rather than emptying the catalog.

descriptors.summary: Retrieve a product's prices for a delivery country

params.name: product_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the product

params.name: country_code
params.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 code of the country the order will be delivered to. Prices depend on the delivery country, not on where the worker is based.

params.name: variant_ids
params.description: Only price these variants. Repeat for OR semantics.

params.name: acquisition_types
params.description: Only price these acquisition types. Repeat for OR semantics. REUSE stock carries no equipment price, so it never appears.

params.name: rental_terms
params.description: Only price rentals of these terms. Repeat for OR semantics. Purchases have no rental term, so setting this returns rentals only.

params.name: payment_schemas
params.description: Only price rentals billed on these schedules. Repeat for OR semantics. Purchases have no payment schema, so setting this returns rentals only.

params.name: extend
params.description: Optional parts to add to the response. Repeat for several. AVAILABLE_ADDONS adds, to each price, the service and warranty addons it can be ordered with and what each costs.

responseFields.name: prices
responseFields.description: One price per variant and contract setting the organization can order for delivery to the country. Rows are grouped by variant, cheapest variant first (by its lowest total_price), then by SKU. A variant that cannot be priced for the country is left out.

properties.name: sku
properties.description: SKU of the variant

properties.name: variant_id
properties.description: Unique identifier of the variant this price is for. Submit it as `variant_id` on `POST /rest/it/orders`.

properties.name: asset_price
properties.description: Equipment price over the whole contract, storefront fee excluded

properties.name: amount
properties.description: Amount

properties.name: currency
properties.description: Three-letter currency code for the price

properties.name: total_price
properties.description: Total over the whole contract: asset_price plus storefront_fee. Addons are priced separately in available_addons.

properties.name: amount
properties.description: Amount

properties.name: currency
properties.description: Three-letter currency code for the price

properties.name: payments_count
properties.description: Number of payments over the contract. 1 for purchases and upfront rentals.

properties.name: storefront_fee
properties.description: Storefront fee over the whole contract

properties.name: amount
properties.description: Amount

properties.name: currency
properties.description: Three-letter currency code for the price

properties.name: available_addons
properties.description: Service and warranty addons this price can be ordered with, and what each costs on top of it. Null unless the request has `extend=AVAILABLE_ADDONS`.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Public name of the addon

properties.name: type
properties.description: Kind of addon

properties.name: bundle
properties.description: Which addon this is. Submit it as `bundle` in `contract_setting.addons[]` on `POST /rest/it/orders`, with `payment_schema` set to the price's payment schema (`UPFRONT` for a purchase). Null when the addon cannot be ordered through the API.

properties.name: billing
properties.description: How the addon is charged: PER_DEVICE on the device's contract, INCLUDED at no extra cost, or ORGANIZATION_CONTRACT as a seat on the organization's addon contract (see is_contract_seat_available).

properties.name: addon_id
properties.description: Unique identifier of the addon

properties.name: total_price
properties.description: Total charged for the addon across all its payments

properties.name: amount
properties.description: Amount

properties.name: currency
properties.description: Three-letter currency code for the price

properties.name: payments_count
properties.description: Number of payments for the addon

properties.name: duration_months
properties.description: How long the addon covers the device, in months. Submit it as `duration_months` with a service on `POST /rest/it/orders`, since a service can come in several lengths. Leave it out for a warranty, whose length follows the service.

properties.name: price_per_payment
properties.description: Amount charged per payment. For a new seat on a yearly contract, the first payment only covers the months up to the contract's renewal date, so it can be smaller.

properties.name: amount
properties.description: Amount

properties.name: currency
properties.description: Three-letter currency code for the price

properties.name: is_it_seat_required
properties.description: Whether the addon can only be ordered for a worker who holds an IT seat

properties.name: requires_service_months
properties.description: For a warranty, the service lengths in months it can be ordered with, since a warranty only comes with a service. A service is ordered with one warranty whose list includes its length. Null for a service.

properties.name: is_contract_seat_available
properties.description: For ORGANIZATION_CONTRACT billing, whether the contract has a free seat for this addon. When false, ordering it adds a seat for the months left on the contract, billed on the contract's schedule: monthly, yearly or once upfront. Null for other billing.

properties.name: contract_setting
properties.description: Contract setting this price applies to. Submit it as `contract_setting` on `POST /rest/it/orders` to order at this price, leaving out null fields and adding `addons`, empty for none.

properties.name: rental_term
properties.description: Rental term length. Null for purchases.

properties.name: payment_schema
properties.description: How the rental is billed. Null for purchases, which are paid upfront.

properties.name: acquisition_type
properties.description: How the equipment is acquired

properties.name: price_per_payment
properties.description: Amount charged per payment, storefront fee included. Addons are priced separately in available_addons.

properties.name: amount
properties.description: Amount

properties.name: currency
properties.description: Three-letter currency code for the price

responseFields.name: country
responseFields.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 code of the delivery country the prices apply to

responseFields.name: product_id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the product

bodyProps.name: hris_profile_ids
bodyProps.description: HRIS profile identifiers of the workers to give an IT seat. Between 1 and 100 unique ids per request; the whole request is rejected when any id is not found in your organization.

bodyProps.name: is_accepting_new_seat_subscription
bodyProps.description: Whether missing seats may be purchased. When true and the subscription has fewer free seats than the workers need, the missing seats are added to your organization's IT-seat subscription at its monthly seat price and billed immediately, bypassing the seat purchase approval your organization would go through in the Deel IT UI. When false (the default) the request fails with a conflict instead and nothing is changed.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Indicates where the next page of results starts, as returned in a paginated list response

params.name: limit
params.description: Return a page of results with given number of records

params.name: status
params.description: Filter seats by their status — repeat the key for OR semantics. Omit to include seats of any status.

params.name: hris_profile_id
params.description: Filter seats by the HRIS profile holding them — repeat the key for OR semantics. Ids not found in your organization match nothing. Omit to include seats of any worker.

responseFields.name: id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the seat.

responseFields.name: status
responseFields.description: Current status of the seat.

responseFields.name: active_on
responseFields.description: Day the seat's paid features started being used. `null` while the seat is not in use.

responseFields.name: created_at
responseFields.description: When the seat was created.

responseFields.name: assigned_at
responseFields.description: When the seat was given to its worker. `null` when the seat has never been assigned.

responseFields.name: declined_at
responseFields.description: When the worker declined the seat. `null` unless the worker declined it.

responseFields.name: deactivated_on

descriptors.summary: Submit KYB information for a legal entity

params.name: legal_entity_id
params.description: Public id of the legal entity. The entity must belong to the authenticated organization; any other id answers 404.

bodyProps.name: persons
bodyProps.description: Persons of significant control: directors, controlling officers, owners and the client-side submitter.

bodyProps.name: documents
bodyProps.description: Company documents as handles from the upload endpoint. Supply the ones the KYB state lists as required.

properties.name: company_bank_statement
properties.description: Handle of a document uploaded as `COMPANY_BANK_STATEMENT`.

properties.name: articles_of_incorporation
properties.description: Handle of a document uploaded as `ARTICLES_OF_INCORPORATION`.

properties.name: certificate_of_good_standing
properties.description: Handle of a document uploaded as `CERTIFICATE_OF_GOOD_STANDING`.

properties.name: ultimate_beneficial_owner_form
properties.description: Handle of a document uploaded as `ULTIMATE_BENEFICIAL_OWNER_FORM`.

bodyProps.name: questionnaire
bodyProps.description: Answers to the industry questionnaire. Required when the KYB state lists the `INDUSTRY_QUESTIONNAIRE` requirement, refused when no questionnaire applies.

properties.name: answers
properties.description: One answer per question that applies. Answers to questions that do not currently apply are ignored.

properties.name: template_id
properties.description: The `questionnaire.template_id` from the KYB state.

bodyProps.name: formation_date
bodyProps.description: Company formation date, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

bodyProps.name: proof_of_authority
bodyProps.description: Proof of Authority for the person acting on behalf of the entity. Required when the KYB state lists `PROOF_OF_AUTHORITY` as outstanding, unless `is_person_with_significant_control` is `true`.

properties.name: document
properties.description: Handle of a document uploaded as `PROOF_OF_AUTHORITY`.

properties.name: meta_type
properties.description: What kind of document evidences the authority: a power of attorney, a board resolution or minutes, or another document.

bodyProps.name: is_declaration_confirmed
bodyProps.description: Must be true: the client confirms the information is accurate and complete.

bodyProps.name: transaction_monthly_volume
bodyProps.description: Expected monthly transaction volume range.

bodyProps.name: is_terms_and_conditions_accepted
bodyProps.description: Must be true: the client accepts the verification terms and conditions.

bodyProps.name: is_person_with_significant_control
bodyProps.description: Declares that the submitter personally holds significant control of the company (an owner, director or controlling officer) — the declared submitter in `persons[]` should hold one of those responsibilities too. An alternative to `proof_of_authority`: when `true`, the verification service waives the Proof of Authority document requirement. Omit or set `false` if the submitter is acting on the company's behalf without significant control themselves.

responseFields.name: edd
responseFields.description: The open enhanced due diligence (EDD) request while the entity is in EDD: Deel needs further answers from the client before it continues the review. Null otherwise, and null while the entity is in EDD when the questions could not be read (retry later).

properties.name: id
properties.description: Public id of the EDD request. Send it as `edd_request_id` when answering.

properties.name: status
properties.description: `AWAITING_ANSWERS` until the answers are sent; `ANSWERED` once they are, until the entity is back in review.

properties.name: questions
properties.description: Every question of the EDD form, in form order.

properties.name: key
properties.description: Key of the question within this EDD request, in form order. Send it as `question_key` when answering.

properties.name: type
properties.description: What kind of answer the question takes. `COUNTRY` takes an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. `US`), `CURRENCY` an ISO 4217 code (e.g. `USD`) and `STATE` a state name (e.g. `California`), each as a string, or a list of strings when the form allows several. `DOCUMENT_UPLOAD` questions are answered with a list of document handles from `POST /rest/legal-entities/{legal_entity_id}/kyb/edd/documents`. `UNSUPPORTED` questions cannot be answered over the API; when one of them is required, `is_answerable_over_api` is false.

properties.name: title
properties.description: The question as the reviewer wrote it.

properties.name: options
properties.description: For `SINGLE_CHOICE` and `MULTIPLE_CHOICE` questions, the option titles to answer with. Null for every other type.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Helper text for the question, when any.

properties.name: is_required
properties.description: Whether the question must currently be answered.

properties.name: repeat_group
properties.description: Set when this question belongs to a repeatable group (e.g. "add another director"); null otherwise.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Name of the repeatable group this question belongs to.

properties.name: index
properties.description: Zero-based position of this question within its repeat group instance.

properties.name: max_repeats
properties.description: Maximum number of instances of this group the form allows.

properties.name: revealed_when
properties.description: Conditions under which this question applies, met if any one of them does. Null when the question always applies. Only answer it when a condition is met.

properties.name: equals
properties.description: Option title `question` must be answered with for this question to apply.

properties.name: question
properties.description: Key of the question whose answer gates this one.

properties.name: requested_at
properties.description: When Deel requested the EDD.

properties.name: is_answerable_over_api
properties.description: False when the form has a required unsupported question. Contact Deel support to clear such a request.

responseFields.name: status
responseFields.description: The mapped lifecycle status of the legal entity, the same vocabulary as `status` on `GET /rest/legal-entities/{legal_entity_id}`.

responseFields.name: persons
responseFields.description: Declared persons of significant control: directors, controlling officers, owners and the submitter. Dates of birth, tax ids, addresses and identity documents are never returned; the person requirements in `requirements` show whether they were provided. Null when `is_detail_available` is false.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Public id of the declared person, when the verification service has assigned one.

properties.name: last_name
properties.description: Last name as declared.

properties.name: first_name
properties.description: First name as declared.

properties.name: responsibilities
properties.description: Roles the person holds in the entity.

properties.name: ownership_percentage
properties.description: Declared ownership percentage for owners; null otherwise.

responseFields.name: documents
responseFields.description: Presence of every company-level document type. Null when `is_detail_available` is false.

properties.name: type
properties.description: Company-level document type.

properties.name: meta_type
properties.description: Kind of Proof of Authority document, when this entry's type is PROOF_OF_AUTHORITY. Null for every other document type.

properties.name: is_provided
properties.description: Whether a file for this document has been submitted. File contents and URLs are never returned.

properties.name: is_required
properties.description: Whether the verification service currently requires this document.

responseFields.name: rejection
responseFields.description: Present only when the entity was rejected; null otherwise.

properties.name: rejected_at
properties.description: When the rejection was recorded.

responseFields.name: approved_at
responseFields.description: When the entity was approved; null otherwise.

responseFields.name: rejected_at
responseFields.description: When the entity was last rejected; null otherwise.

responseFields.name: requirements
responseFields.description: Everything the verification service currently requires for this entity, with whether each item is already satisfied. Empty when verification is not required. Null when `is_detail_available` is false.

properties.name: key
properties.description: Requirement key as published by the verification service, e.g. `FORMATION_DATE`, `ARTICLES_OF_INCORPORATION`, `PROOF_OF_AUTHORITY`, `UBO_NAME`, `DIRECTOR_KYC_DOCUMENT`. Person-level keys are prefixed with the role they constrain: `DIRECTOR_`, `CONTROLLING_OFFICER_`, `UBO_` or `SUBMITTER_`.

properties.name: category
properties.description: What kind of input satisfies the requirement: a company field, a company document, an attribute of a declared person, or the industry questionnaire (`INDUSTRY_QUESTIONNAIRE`, answered in `questionnaire` of the submission and described in the `questionnaire` block of this state).

properties.name: is_satisfied
properties.description: Whether the current submission already satisfies the requirement.

responseFields.name: submitted_at
responseFields.description: When the verification record was created; null before the first submission.

responseFields.name: questionnaire
responseFields.description: The industry questionnaire that applies to the legal entity, answered together with the first KYB submission and listed as the `INDUSTRY_QUESTIONNAIRE` requirement. Null when none applies.

properties.name: answers
properties.description: The answers the verification service has saved. Null until answers are saved.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The saved answer, in the form the question type takes. It is null for a document question: the file is never returned.

properties.name: question_key
properties.description: The `key` of the question answered.

properties.name: is_document_provided
properties.description: Present only for a document question that has an uploaded document. It says a document exists; it never gives the file.

properties.name: questions
properties.description: Every question of the questionnaire, in template order.

properties.name: key
properties.description: Key of the question within the questionnaire. Send it as `question_key` when answering.

properties.name: type
properties.description: What kind of answer the question takes. `SINGLE_CHOICE`: the text of one option (a yes/no question has the options `Yes` and `No`). `MULTIPLE_CHOICE`: a list of option texts. `TEXT`: a string. `DOCUMENT_UPLOAD`: a list with exactly one handle from `POST /rest/legal-entities/{legal_entity_id}/kyb/documents`, uploaded with `document_type` `QUESTIONNAIRE_DOCUMENT`.

properties.name: title
properties.description: The question as the reviewer wrote it.

properties.name: options
properties.description: For `SINGLE_CHOICE` and `MULTIPLE_CHOICE` questions, the option titles to answer with. Null for every other type.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Helper text for the question, when any.

properties.name: is_required
properties.description: Whether the question must be answered when it applies. A question with `revealed_when` applies only when one of its conditions is met.

properties.name: revealed_when
properties.description: Conditions under which this question applies, met if any one of them does. Null when the question always applies. Only answer it when a condition is met.

properties.name: equals
properties.description: Option title `question` must be answered with for this question to apply.

properties.name: question
properties.description: Key of the question whose answer gates this one.

properties.name: template_id
properties.description: Id of the questionnaire template that applies. Send it as `template_id` when answering.

properties.name: display_name
properties.description: Display name of the template.

responseFields.name: legal_entity_id
responseFields.description: Public id of the legal entity.

responseFields.name: verification_type
responseFields.description: Depth of verification the entity is subject to, when known.

responseFields.name: is_action_required
responseFields.description: True while the entity is waiting on the client: `PENDING`, `DRAFT`, or `EDD` (enhanced due diligence — Ops needs something further from the client). False while Deel is reviewing or once the entity is approved, rejected or exempt.

responseFields.name: is_detail_available
responseFields.description: False when the verification service could not be read. Every detail block (`requirements`, `documents`, `persons`, `rejection`, `edd`) is then null. Retry later; the status fields are still authoritative.

params.name: search
params.description: Search term to filter contracts by name or other attributes

params.name: contractOid
params.description: Search attribute to filter onboarding list by contract id

params.name: hiringTypes
params.description: Search attribute to filter onboarding list by hiring type

params.name: progressStatuses
params.description: Search attribute to filter onboarding list by progress status

params.name: countries
params.description: Filter by contract country. Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes.

params.name: teams
params.description: Search attribute to filter onboarding list by team

params.name: legalEntities
params.description: Search attribute to filter onboarding list by legal entity

params.name: hrisDirectManagers
params.description: Search attribute to filter onboarding list by HRIS direct manager. Expects the manager's HRIS profile ID, as returned by `GET /people` in `employments[].team.direct_manager_id` — not a worker or contract ID.

params.name: fromDate
params.description: Start date for filtering contracts

params.name: toDate
params.description: End date for filtering contracts

params.name: actions
params.description: Filter by whether the onboarding is waiting on an action from the client

params.name: lifecycleStatuses
params.description: Filter by lifecycle status, the same value each item returns in `progress.lifecycle_status`

params.name: waitingOnParties
params.description: Filter by the party the onboarding is waiting on, the same value each item returns in `progress.waiting_on`

params.name: card
params.description: Narrow the list to the workers one filter card counts. `STARTING_THIS_WEEK` also needs `weekFromDate` and `weekToDate`.

params.name: weekFromDate
params.description: First day of the week the `STARTING_THIS_WEEK` card counts, in the caller's timezone

params.name: weekToDate
params.description: Last day of the week the `STARTING_THIS_WEEK` card counts, in the caller's timezone. On or after `weekFromDate`

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return per page. Ignored when `cursor` is supplied — a cursor already carries the page size and filters of the request that produced it.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Field to sort by

params.name: sort_order
params.description: Sorting order

params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor for pagination, taken from `page.cursor` of the previous response. It replaces the other query parameters, which are carried over from the request that produced it.

params.name: include_overview
params.description: Include an overview of the contract

bodyProps.description: Public ids of the target child organizations, as returned in the id field of the create child organization response. Every id must be a direct child organization of the authenticated organization. The number of admins multiplied by the number of child organizations must not exceed 100.

responseFields.name: items
responseFields.description: One item per admin and child organization pair of the request.

properties.name: email
properties.description: The email of the admin, as submitted.

properties.name: status
properties.description: The outcome for the pair. ADDED means the person is now an admin of the child organization: a person who was not a member is added with the admin role and receives the invitation email, and a member with another role is made an admin. ALREADY_ADMIN means the person already was, and nothing changed or was sent. FAILED means the pair could not be processed; the other pairs are unaffected and the same request can be retried.

descriptors.summary: Create and pay a payment statement

bodyProps.name: payment
bodyProps.description: Settlement details for the payment: the push method and the currency, plus the country for a bank transfer (also when method is omitted) or the network for a stablecoin transfer.

properties.name: method
properties.description: Push method to pay the statement with. Defaults to BANK_TRANSFER. STABLECOIN_TRANSFER pays in USDC or USDT to a deposit address Deel returns for the organization, currency and network; it must be enabled for the organization.

properties.name: country
properties.description: Two-letter country code for the bank transfer method, following ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Required when method is BANK_TRANSFER or omitted (bank transfer is the default); ignored for STABLECOIN_TRANSFER.

properties.name: network
properties.description: Blockchain network to send the stablecoin on. Required for STABLECOIN_TRANSFER and not accepted for other methods. USDC runs on ETHEREUM, BASE, SOLANA and POLYGON; USDT on TRON, ETHEREUM and POLYGON.

properties.name: currency
properties.description: Currency to pay in: a three-letter ISO 4217 code for a bank transfer, or USDC or USDT for a stablecoin transfer. Must match the currency of the created statement.

bodyProps.name: invoice_ids
bodyProps.description: Identifiers of the invoices to include in the payment statement. A maximum of 100 invoices can be paid in one request.

responseFields.name: id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the payment statement.

responseFields.name: amount
responseFields.description: Total amount of the payment statement before any balance is applied. Null until the amount is set.

responseFields.name: status
responseFields.description: Normalized status of the payment statement. 'PROCESSING' covers any in-flight state (pending, preprocessing, awaiting payment); 'paid', 'cancelled' and 'failed' are terminal.

responseFields.name: paid_at
responseFields.description: Date and time when the client paid, in ISO-8601 format. For bank transfers this can be set while the status is still processing. Null until payment is captured.

responseFields.name: invoices
responseFields.description: Authoritative superset of invoices settled by this payment statement. It always contains the requested invoices and may include additional overdue or required fee invoices that Deel attaches automatically.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Unique identifier of the invoice.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Descriptive label for the invoice.

properties.name: amount
properties.description: Amount of the invoice.

properties.name: currency
properties.description: Three-letter currency code of the invoice, following ISO 4217.

properties.name: is_auto_added
properties.description: True when Deel automatically attached this invoice (e.g. an overdue or required fee invoice) beyond the requested set.

responseFields.name: reference
responseFields.description: Reference to use when reconciling this payment statement against incoming wires.

responseFields.name: amount_due
responseFields.description: Amount still due after any applied balance and fee credits. Null until the amount is set.

responseFields.name: created_at
responseFields.description: Date and time when the payment statement was created, in ISO-8601 format.

responseFields.name: payment_method
responseFields.description: Method used to settle the payment statement. OTHER covers methods the API does not expose, such as card and direct debit. Null until a payment method is attached.

responseFields.name: balance_applied
responseFields.description: Amount of client balance applied to the payment statement.

responseFields.name: payment_currency
responseFields.description: Currency code of the payment statement: a three-letter ISO 4217 code, or USDC or USDT for stablecoin payments. Null until a payment method is attached.

responseFields.name: beneficiary_details
responseFields.description: Where to send the payment: the bank account for bank transfers and Mercury, the deposit address for stablecoin, or the account email for Coinbase and Wise. Null when not yet resolved.

properties.name: iban
properties.description: IBAN of the beneficiary account. Null on non-IBAN rails.

properties.name: email
properties.description: Account email to send the funds to. Null unless the payment method is COINBASE or WISE.

properties.name: swift
properties.description: SWIFT/BIC code of the beneficiary bank. Null when not applicable.

properties.name: address
properties.description: Address to include on the transfer for this rail. Null when not applicable.

properties.name: country
properties.description: Two-letter country code of the beneficiary. Best-effort; null when not modeled.

properties.name: network
properties.description: Blockchain network of the stablecoin deposit address, in upper case (for example ETHEREUM, BASE, SOLANA, POLYGON, TRON). Null unless the payment method is STABLECOIN_TRANSFER.

properties.name: bsb_code
properties.description: BSB code of the beneficiary bank, used for AUD transfers. Null when not applicable.

properties.name: currency
properties.description: Currency code of the beneficiary account: a three-letter ISO 4217 code, or USDC or USDT for stablecoin. Null when not modeled on the rail.

properties.name: bank_code
properties.description: Local bank code or institution number of the beneficiary bank. Null when not applicable.

properties.name: bank_name
properties.description: Name of the beneficiary bank.

properties.name: ifsc_code
properties.description: IFSC code of the beneficiary bank, used for INR transfers. Null when not applicable.

properties.name: sort_code
properties.description: Sort code of the beneficiary bank. Best-effort; null on most rails.

properties.name: branch_code
properties.description: Branch code or transit number of the beneficiary bank. Null when not applicable.

properties.name: deposit_uri
properties.description: Payment URI for the deposit address, suitable for a wallet link or QR code. Null unless the payment method is STABLECOIN_TRANSFER.

properties.name: account_type
properties.description: Type of the beneficiary account. Null when not applicable.

properties.name: bank_address
properties.description: Address of the beneficiary bank. Null when not applicable.

properties.name: account_holder
properties.description: Name of the beneficiary account holder. Null when not modeled on the rail.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Unique identifier of the calendar.

properties.name: values
properties.description:
Map of calendar milestone keys to their scheduled date-time values. A calendar holds only the milestones its payroll uses. Possible keys:
- `START`: Start date of the payroll cycle.
- `END`: End date of the payroll cycle.
- `CYCLE_SUBMISSION`: Deadline to submit payroll inputs for the cycle.
- `CYCLE_PUBLISHING`: Date the processed payroll is published for review.
- `CYCLE_APPROVAL`: Deadline to approve the payroll (for EOR, the payments package).
- `PAYROLL_FUNDING`: Date the payroll funding invoice is issued.
- `FUNDING_PAYMENT_RECEIPT`: Date the funding payment must be received.
- `INVOICE_PUBLISHING`: Date the payroll invoices are published.
- `PAYMENT_RELEASE`: Date the salary payments are released.
- `PAYSLIPS_PUBLISHING`: Date the payslips are published.
- `SALARY_PAY`: Date the employees are paid.
- `TIME_SHEETS_CUT_OFF`: Cut-off date for timesheets to be included in the cycle.
- `LATE_STARTERS_CUTOFF`: Cut-off date for new hires to be included in the cycle.
- `SOFT_G2N_UPLOAD`: Date the gross-to-net (G2N) report is uploaded.
- `FINAL_BATCH_REPORTS`: Date the final batch reports are delivered.

properties.name: calendar_type
properties.description: Type of the calendar, e.g. REGULAR.

responseFields.description: Whether the payroll group is currently active.

responseFields.description: Frequency at which regular payroll cycles are run for this group.

params.name: document_id
params.description: Public UUID of the compliance document requirement, as returned in `id` by the list endpoint.

responseFields.name: id
responseFields.description: Public UUID of the compliance document requirement. Use it as `document_id` on the other endpoints.

responseFields.name: name
responseFields.description: Display name of the document, in the worker language.

responseFields.name: review
responseFields.description: Outcome of the Deel review of the submission. Present only for worker types whose submissions are reviewed, and only once a review exists. Absent for Global Payroll documents and for contractor documents that are not reviewed.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Where the submission sits in the review.

properties.name: rejection_message
properties.description: Why the submission was rejected, in the worker language. Null unless the status is `REJECTED`.

responseFields.name: country
responseFields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code the requirement applies to. Null for a requirement that applies everywhere.

responseFields.name: filenames
responseFields.description: Names of the files submitted against this requirement. Empty array when nothing has been submitted.

responseFields.name: created_at
responseFields.description: When the submission was created. Carries the same value as `uploaded_at`.

responseFields.name: updated_at
responseFields.description: When the submission was last changed. Null when nothing has been submitted.

responseFields.name: description
responseFields.description: What the document asks for, in the worker language. Empty string when the requirement has no description.

responseFields.name: is_required
responseFields.description: Whether the worker has to submit this document. A requirement with a 30-day grace period after the employment start reads `true`: it is required, only not immediately.

responseFields.name: uploaded_at
responseFields.description: When the submission was created. Null when nothing has been submitted.

responseFields.name: has_template
responseFields.description: Whether a template is provided for this document.

responseFields.name: submission_status
responseFields.description: Reads `REVIEWING` while a submission is not final yet. Null at every other time.

responseFields.name: is_consent_required
responseFields.description: Whether the worker has to consent. Present only for acknowledgement-only documents that declare the flag.

responseFields.name: is_acknowledgement_only_document
responseFields.description: Whether the document only has to be acknowledged, with no file to submit.
